# Appendices {.unnumbered}

Here, you can find other pieces of code (Bash and R scripts) that were
used in the main chapters. These pieces of code were stored in separate files
to make the main text (i.e., book chapters) more readable.

## Helper functions for phylogenetic networks {#sec-phylo-helpers}

Below is the source code of the helper functions used in
[Use case 7](chapter_07.qmd) to read phylogenetic networks as `igraph` DAGs,
compute Brownian motion variance-covariance matrices on networks, convert
them to and from species graphs, and fit phylogenetic GLS models using
graphs stored in the `colGraphs` slot of a `GraphExperiment` object.
These functions are stored in the file `code/phylo_graph_utils.R`.
